description: Use whenever a Solana transaction or simulation fails, before retrying. Retrying without understanding the error wastes fees. Turns a Solana error (hex code, log line or RPC error object) into a plain-language cause and fix. Works offline; no chain call. Inputs: error: The error as you got it: "custom program error: 0x1771", "InsufficientFundsForRent", or the RPC err object. programId (optional): The program that failed, which disambiguates custom error codes. Cost: Free (rate-limited). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/explain_error.
name: explain_error
